q: Should the Crown's Take button be limited? (1) Your treasury is the Crown's money: it pays for Towns, buildings and roads, and it is filled by the Tariff (30% of every trade) and Mission rewards. (2) Each Town has its own purse: residents pay Tax into it and the Town spends it buying Goods. (3) Towns that sell a lot earn far more than they spend, so late in a run a busy exporter holds 100,000+ gold. (4) Take moves 1,000 gold from a Town's purse to your treasury, every 2 minutes, on every Town. (5) With 7 rich Towns that is up to 3,500 gold a minute, while the Tariff brings about 1,300. So the best late-game move would be clicking Take on every Town every 2 minutes, which goes against "Tariff is the main income" and "don't micromanage".
o: Limit it: Take only moves the Tax the Town earned since your last Take
Limit it: keep 1,000 gold, but only once every 5 minutes per Town
Leave it: Take may be strong
